nodes.label: Document Bundle Layout
nodes.rationale: Defines on-disk structure so page identities stay deterministic, overlays stay separate from generated artifacts, and review history remains append-only.
nodes.community_name: Spec 0002: V1 Bundle Layout and Data Shape

nodes.label: Normalized Page Graph
nodes.rationale: Minimum graph model covers regions, lines, spans, notes, and provenance edges so downstream merge, review, and export share one structure.

nodes.label: V1 Typography and Role Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Typography facets are orthogonal (weight, slant, baseline shift); semantic roles like footnote-marker are independent of font style.
nodes.community_name: Spec 0002: V1 Bundle Layout and Data Shape

nodes.label: Review Overlays
nodes.rationale: Human-authored overlays must remain separate from generated artifacts; review history is append-only.
nodes.community_name: Spec 0002: V1 Bundle Layout and Data Shape

nodes.label: Evaluation Score Families
nodes.rationale: Avoid one blended score; keep text, structure, and style families separate so failures remain visible.

nodes.label: Evaluation Review Flags
nodes.rationale: Scores alone are insufficient; flags surface watchlist loss, style collapse, ambiguous note linkage, and pass disagreement.

nodes.label: V1 Gold Data Expectations
nodes.rationale: Gold slices may be partial and page-local while still covering text, watchlist, style, notes, and optional structure.

nodes.label: Ordered V1 Implementation Phases
nodes.rationale: Build order reduces irreversible architecture choices; each phase leaves an executable check and evidence for the next decision.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Hosted OCR Inference
nodes.rationale: No phase adds local OCR-model inference; live tests target pinned Hugging Face deployments.

nodes.label: Recommended Initial CLI
nodes.rationale: Ship prepare/run/eval/inspect-bundle first; add review or endpoint-management commands only after phases prove CLI is the right boundary.

nodes.label: Candidate Model Bake-Off
nodes.rationale: Measure olmocr, kraken, and licensed alternatives by quality dimension, page class, latency, cost, and license before integrating losers.

nodes.label: Evidence-Bound Human Review
nodes.rationale: Operators edit overlays or gold, never raw witnesses, canonical graphs, Markdown, or RAG exports directly.

nodes.label: Independent Review Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Trust on one dimension never upgrades another; source-quality, preparation, structure, text, typography, and note-linkage certify independently.

nodes.label: Trust States machine/reviewed/corrected
nodes.rationale: machine means no human certification; reviewed accepts unchanged; corrected means human changed named dimensions.

nodes.label: Diplomatic Text Review
nodes.rationale: Humans correct text_diplomatic only; text_normalized is regenerated deterministically after overlay replay.

nodes.label: Bundle JSON Export
nodes.rationale: Primary consumer contract preserving structure and provenance for audit, replay, and regeneration of simpler exports.

nodes.label: RAG JSON Export
nodes.rationale: Derived retrieval view with region-first chunking; footnotes are first-class; fixed token windows are not primary boundaries.

nodes.label: Markdown Export
nodes.rationale: Derived evidence-preserving reading view; must not be treated as source of truth or silently merge footnotes into prose.

nodes.label: Footnote Chunk
nodes.rationale: Footnotes must be separately retrievable and linked to marker spans, page, and parent region.

nodes.label: Document-Level Stitched Chunks
nodes.rationale: Stitched chunks derive only from accepted page graph order, never raw OCR text streams.

nodes.label: Preparation Pipeline Stage
nodes.rationale: Preparation is a first-class quality lever; prepared images are preserved artifacts; recipe changes create distinct run inputs.

nodes.label: Page Subdivision into OCR Units
nodes.rationale: Dense dictionary pages may need columns or fixed-tiles; subdivision preserves logical page identity under prepared units.

nodes.label: Preparation Recipe
nodes.rationale: Stable named serializable recipes capture render DPI, color, deskew, denoise, crop, binarize, and dewarp modes.

nodes.label: Coordinate and Image Provenance
nodes.rationale: Boxes name coordinate-space ids; OCR evidence is rejected when coordinate identity cannot resolve through the transform chain.

nodes.label: Competing Preparation Recipes
nodes.rationale: Hard pages and different runners may need alternate preparations; evaluation should compare preparation alternatives, not only OCR.

nodes.label: Dual Diplomatic/Normalized Text
nodes.rationale: Keeping only one text field damages either philological evidence or software usability; both fields are required.

nodes.label: Historical Character Preservation
nodes.rationale: Default preserves æ/ǣ/þ/ð in both layers; ASCII fallbacks belong in retrieval-oriented fields only.

nodes.label: Retrieval Convenience Text Fields
nodes.rationale: text_search and ascii fallbacks must never replace text_diplomatic or text_normalized.

nodes.label: Abstaining Merge Policy
nodes.rationale: Merge only above calibrated thresholds; otherwise retain disagreement and create targeted review rather than silent guessed structure.

nodes.label: Structure Scaffold Selection
nodes.rationale: Prefer strongest coordinate-rich layout pass as scaffold and fit other evidence onto it to avoid merging incompatible hierarchies.

nodes.label: Machine/Merge/Trust Confidence Triad
nodes.rationale: machine_confidence, merge_confidence, and trust_state are different concepts and must not be collapsed.

nodes.label: V1 Page Class Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Undifferentiated evaluation pools hide failures; operational classes drive preparation, evaluation cohorts, and review expectations.

nodes.label: Page-Class Evaluation Cohorts
nodes.rationale: Compare within same page class and preparation mode first so dense dictionary pages do not disappear inside prose averages.

nodes.label: Standard OCR Intermediate Structure
nodes.rationale: Standardize on evidence-preserving OCR structure first; premature domain ontology distorts non-dictionary texts and flattens provenance.

nodes.label: TEI P5 as Downstream Reference
nodes.rationale: Use TEI P5 dictionaries chapter as modeling reference for downstream Python/Pydantic targets, not as primary bochord XML output.

nodes.label: Downstream Transformation Packages
nodes.rationale: Dictionary, grammar, and reader packages transform page graph plus review into domain models while preserving provenance.

nodes.label: Runner Batch Execution Policy
nodes.rationale: Batch size is experimental evidence, not folklore; packaging and batching are runner-specific and recorded in provenance.

nodes.label: olmOCR Runner Execution
nodes.rationale: olmocr is first-class but not the architecture; image-to-PDF packaging is an explicit bochord policy choice.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Deployment Target
nodes.rationale: Local laptop prepares and orchestrates but never runs OCR inference or downloads weights as fallback; endpoint failure must not silent-local-fallback.

nodes.label: RunnerCapability Schema
nodes.rationale: Persist capability declarations so orchestrator knows accepted input kinds, batching, and packaging without speculative plugin frameworks.

nodes.label: RunnerExecutionBatch Record
nodes.rationale: One invocation record answers which revision, packaging, batch size, failures, and retries produced each witness.

nodes.label: Adapter-First Interface Extraction
nodes.rationale: Build two or three real adapters first; extract smallest common protocol only after observing differing behavior.

nodes.label: ReviewTask Packet
nodes.rationale: Self-contained task packets bind dimensions, evidence, allowed actions, guideline version, and base graph revision; no generic review screen.

nodes.label: PageOverlay Append-Only Log
nodes.rationale: Event log is append-only truth; OverlayState is a replay cache; rebase creates successor overlays rather than mutating predecessors.

nodes.label: correct_text Event Semantics
nodes.rationale: correct_text carries replacement text_diplomatic only; normalized text is never operator input.

nodes.label: GoldDocument Annotation Binding
nodes.rationale: Gold binds to page, run, graph revision, and prepared-image checksum; changed image or graph requires explicit rebase.

nodes.label: do_not_score Exclusions
nodes.rationale: Exclusions are distinct from illegibility, require reasons, and remain reportable in denominators.

nodes.label: Held-Out Gold Splits
nodes.rationale: Train/dev/test assignment occurs before engine comparison; test slices stay hidden from prompt and threshold selection.

nodes.label: DocumentBundle Pydantic Model
nodes.rationale: Pydantic models implement accepted ADR/spec contracts; if prose and code diverge, resolve architecture first then update both.

nodes.label: RagDocument and StitchedChunk Models
nodes.rationale: V1 retrieval chunks stay provisional region/note/table views; TEI-inspired semantics remain downstream until evaluable.

nodes.label: Reject eScriptorium as Review Boundary
nodes.rationale: Native PAGE export preserves region/line text but drops Word/span ids and drifts from prepared-image identity; Phase 1 hard-stops.

nodes.label: bochord.json Sidecar Evidence
nodes.rationale: Sidecar remains honest source for span typography, note linkage, provenance, and diplomatic/normalized split that PAGE never carries.

nodes.label: Python 3.10+ Type Hints
nodes.rationale: Prefer builtins and | None over typing.Dict/List/Optional; use parameterized collection types and aliases in types.py.

nodes.label: Separation of Concerns and 60-line Methods
nodes.rationale: Limit methods to ~60 lines; specific exceptions in try blocks; custom exceptions in exc.py.

nodes.label: Pydantic vs Dataclass vs TypedDict
nodes.rationale: User-facing models use Pydantic; internal-only models may use dataclass or TypedDict instead of plain dicts.

nodes.label: Gold Annotation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Freeze dataset split before model work; coverage gates denominators; second-annotate and adjudicate before benchmark use.

nodes.label: GoldCoverage
nodes.rationale: Without coverage, metrics silently exclude spans; annotate coverage before object-level gold.

nodes.label: Byte-Identical Evaluation Reproducibility
nodes.rationale: Any score-file difference indicates non-reproducible inputs, profile drift, or toolchain skew — not model quality.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Operator laptop prepares/submits/validates; never download full model weights or add local GPU fallback.

nodes.label: Immutable Model Commit Pinning
nodes.rationale: Do not deploy main, a moving tag, or a bare model name as reproducibility identity.

nodes.label: Custom OCR Container
nodes.rationale: Use custom containers when managed engines cannot honor vision/document contracts; pin image digest, never latest.

nodes.label: Client-Side Queue for Cold Starts
nodes.rationale: HF may return temporary gateway errors during scale-from-zero and does not guarantee app-level OCR queuing.

nodes.label: Local Laptop Boundary
nodes.rationale: Local work is preparation, queueing, validation, evaluation, and review; endpoint unavailability must persist failed batches, never silent local inference.

nodes.label: OCR Produces Evidence
nodes.rationale: Preserve evidence, compare competing passes, evaluate against gold, then derive graphs and exports.

nodes.label: Separate Text Structure Style Score Families
nodes.rationale: Do not trust a blended score; review pages that pass text but fail structure or style.
nodes.norm_label: separate text structure style score families

nodes.label: When To Rerun vs Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Rerun OCR when preparation/recipe/runner changes; rebuild derived graph/eval/export from preserved witnesses when only derived logic changes.

nodes.label: PageXmlInterchangeService
nodes.rationale: Keep BundlePage JSON canonical; PAGE XML is interchange only; eScriptorium remains a manual external gate.

nodes.label: Reject ocrd-models for Spike
nodes.rationale: ocrd-models lacks full Python 3.13 support; use stdlib XML for the bounded PAGE subset.

nodes.label: regex Unicode Grapheme Clusters
nodes.rationale: stdlib normalizes Unicode but does not segment extended grapheme clusters; regex supplies \X.

nodes.label: Pillow and pypdfium2 Stack
nodes.rationale: pypdfium2 replaces a two-library pypdf+renderer stack for render and embedded raster extraction.

nodes.label: StyleEvaluationSummary
nodes.rationale: Nest typography and note linkage under style so top-level families are exactly text, structure, style.

nodes.label: Preparation Recipe Variants
nodes.rationale: A recipe id with different serialized content is a distinct variant, never a silent overwrite.

nodes.label: Weighted Evaluation Cohorts
nodes.rationale: Aggregate from summed numerators/denominators, never mean page values; baseline groups by page class first.

nodes.label: Hosted olmOCR Execution Path
nodes.rationale: Use pinned olmocr for v4 prompt builder only; httpx for raw responses; never local inference or InferenceClient.image_to_text.
